title: Scaling GR(1) Synthesis via a Compositional Framework for LTL Discrete Event Control
abstract: arXiv:2506.16557v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a compositional approach to controller synthesis of discrete event system controllers with linear temporal logic (LTL) goals. We exploit the modular structure of the plant to be controlled, given as a set of labelled transition systems (LTS), to mitigate state explosion that monolithic approaches to synthesis are prone to. Maximally permissive safe controllers are iteratively built for subsets of the plant LTSs by solving weaker control problems. Observational synthesis equivalence is used to reduce the size of the controlled subset of the plant by abstracting away local events. The result of synthesis is also compositional, a set of controllers that when run in parallel ensure the LTL goal. We implement synthesis in the MTSA tool for an expressive subset of LTL, GR(1), and show it computes solutions to that can be up to 1000 times larger than those that the monolithic approach can solve.

translated_title: 通过LTL离散事件控制的组合框架扩展GR(1)综合的可扩展性
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种组合式方法，用于综合具有线性时序逻辑（LTL）目标的离散事件系统控制器。我们利用被控对象（以一组标记转移系统（LTS）的形式给出）的模块化结构，来缓解单体式综合方法容易出现的状态爆炸问题。通过求解较弱的控制问题，为被控对象LTS的子集迭代地构建最大宽容安全控制器。利用观测综合等价性，通过抽象掉局部事件来减小被控对象受控子集的规模。综合的结果也是组合式的，即一组控制器，当它们并行运行时能确保实现LTL目标。我们在MTSA工具中针对LTL的一个富有表达力的子集GR(1)实现了该综合方法，并证明它所能计算的解的规模可达单体方法所能求解规模的1000倍。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种组合式的GR(1)控制器综合框架，利用被控系统的模块化结构和观测综合等价性来缓解状态爆炸问题，能够求解规模达到单体式方法1000倍的LTL离散事件控制综合问题。
en_tdlr: A compositional framework for GR(1) synthesis in LTL discrete event control that exploits the modular structure of the plant and observational synthesis equivalence to mitigate state explosion, enabling solutions up to 1000 times larger than monolithic approaches.
